name: dnbg-work-summary
description: Turn your merged and open GitHub PRs into an audience-shaped recap — shipped work over a window, or what's in flight.

owners.title: GitHub owners to search for your work
owners.description: Comma-separated list of GitHub orgs and/or personal logins, e.g. 'acme-corp,yourname'. The work-summary skill searches their repos for your PRs and issues. Leave empty and the skill asks which to search each time.
